I was lucky to get the FISP coupon this year, so I have one bag of NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer in town. Since my whole farm is only 0.35 hectares, I will split that bag across all my plots, and this main maize plot will get its share — that works out to roughly 35 kg of nitrogen per hectare. I will also put two wheelbarrows of manure on this plot because it is my own land and I want to keep the soil good, and I am using the improved maize seed that came with the subsidy. Weeding this intercropped plot takes many days, so my family will spend about twelve labor days here, but I will not hire anyone because the plot is too small to waste cash on outside labor, and I have no pump or pipe for irrigation.
